en.s: The Battle of Myriokephalon (also known as the Battle of Myriocephalum, Greek: Μάχη του Μυριοκέφαλου, Turkish: Miryokefalon Savaşı or Düzbel Muharebesi) was a battle between the Byzantine Empire and the Seljuk Turks in the mountains west of Iconium (Konya) in west-central Anatolia on 17 September 1176. The battle was a strategic reverse for the Byzantine forces, who were ambushed when moving through a mountain pass.

zh.s: 米里奥凯法隆战役（又称Myriocephalum战役；希腊语：Μάχη του Μυριοκέφαλου；土耳其语：Miryokefalon Savaşı或Düzbel Muharebesi）于1176年9月17日在安纳托利亚中西部科尼亚以西的山区爆发，交战双方是拜占庭帝国和塞尔柱突厥人。拜占庭军队在穿越山口时遭到伏击，战役以其战略失利告终。

en.t: Louis the Great's daughter, Mary, is crowned "king" of Hungary
en.s: Louis I of Hungary, also known as Louis the Great (Hungarian: Nagy Lajos; Croatian: Ludovik Veliki; Slovak: Ľudovít Veľký) or Louis the Hungarian (Polish: Ludwik Węgierski, Italian: Luigi l'ungherese; 5 March 1326 – 10 September 1382), was King of Hungary and Croatia from 1342 and King of Poland from 1370 until his death in 1382. He was the first child of Charles I of Hungary and his wife, Elizabeth of Poland, to survive infancy.

zh.t: 路易大帝之女玛丽加冕为匈牙利“国王”
zh.s: 匈牙利的路易一世又称路易大帝（匈牙利语：Nagy Lajos；克罗地亚语：Ludovik Veliki；斯洛伐克语：Ľudovít Veľký），也称匈牙利人路易（波兰语：Ludwik Węgierski；意大利语：Luigi l'ungherese；1326年3月5日—1382年9月10日）。他自1342年起担任匈牙利和克罗地亚国王，1370年至1382年去世前兼任波兰国王。他是匈牙利国王查理一世与波兰的伊丽莎白所生、唯一活过婴儿期的子女。

en.s: The Battle of Świecino (named for the village of Świecino, near Żarnowiec Lake, northern Poland) also called the Battle of Żarnowiec or in German Battle of Schwetz, took place on September 17, 1462 during the Thirteen Years' War. The Poles commanded by Piotr Dunin, consisting of some 2000 mercenares and Poles, decisively defeated the 2700 man army of the Teutonic Knights commanded by Fritz Raweneck and Kaspar Nostyc. Auxiliary forces sent by duke Eric II of Pomerania, an ally of the Polish king, did not enter the battle.

zh.s: 希维奇诺战役也称扎尔诺维茨战役或施韦茨战役，因附近村庄希维奇诺得名。1462年9月17日，波兰军队在波兰北部扎尔诺维茨湖附近与条顿骑士团交战。当时，彼得·杜宁指挥约2,000名雇佣兵和波兰士兵，击败了弗里茨·拉韦内克和卡斯帕·诺斯蒂克率领的2,700名条顿骑士团军队。波美拉尼亚公爵埃里克二世派来的援军没有参战。

en.t: The first Finnish-language book, the Abckiria by Mikael Agricola, is published in Stockholm
en.s: Finnish (endonym: suomi [ˈsuo̯mi] or suomen kieli [ˈsuo̯meŋ ˈkie̯li]) is a Finnic language of the Uralic language family, spoken by the majority of the population in Finland and by ethnic Finns outside of Finland. Finnish is one of the two official languages of Finland, alongside Swedish. In Sweden, both Finnish and Meänkieli (which has significant mutual intelligibility with Finnish) are official minority languages.

zh.t: 米卡埃尔·阿格里科拉出版首本芬兰语书籍《ABC书》
zh.s: 芬兰语（本族语名称：suomi或suomen kieli）是乌拉尔语系芬兰语族语言，芬兰多数居民及海外芬兰族群使用。芬兰语与瑞典语同为芬兰官方语言。在瑞典，芬兰语和与其相当互通的梅安语均为官方少数民族语言。

en.s: The siege of Minamata Castle was a short siege of the castle of Minamata. Minamata was the entry point for the Ōtomo lands in Higo province, the castle was guarded by Sagara Yoshihi with 700 soldiers. When Shimazu Toshihisa and Iehisa encamped near the castle with 115,000 men, Yoshihi was forced to surrender. Later, Yoshihi was killed in a surprise attack by Kai Soun's army in the Battle of Hibikinohara.

en.s: The siege of Ghent during the Eighty Years' War by Spanish general Alexander Farnese, Prince of Parma, lasted from October 1583 to 17 September 1584. It was the end phase of the so-called Calvinist Republic of Ghent, which had controlled most of the County of Flanders since radical Protestants seized power on 28 October 1577, claiming a leading role for the city of Ghent in the struggle against the Spanish royal forces and Malcontent Catholics.

zh.s: 八十年战争期间，帕尔马亲王亚历山大·法尔内塞率领西班牙军队围攻根特，时间从1583年10月至1584年9月17日。这是根特加尔文主义共和国的最后阶段。该共和国自1577年10月28日激进新教徒夺权后，控制了佛兰德伯国的大部分地区，并宣称根特在对抗西班牙王室军队和不满天主教徒的斗争中应发挥领导作用。

en.s: The siege of Morlaix took place from 6 September to 17 September 1594 during the French Wars of Religion and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). The siege was fought between the French Royal army under Marshal d'Aumont reinforced by an English contingent under Sir John Norreys who besieged the town of Morlaix, which was held by the combined forces of Spain and the Catholic League of France.

en.t: The city of Boston, Massachusetts, is founded in North America
en.s: Boston ( BAW-stən, ) is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Massachusetts. It serves as a cultural and financial center of New England, a region of the Northeastern United States. Boston has an area of 48.4 square miles (125 km2) and a population of 675,647 as of the 2020 census, making it the third-most populous city in the Northeastern United States after New York City and Philadelphia.

zh.s: 波士顿是美国马萨诸塞州首府和人口最多的城市，也是美国东北部新英格兰地区的文化和金融中心。该市面积48.4平方英里（125平方公里），2020年人口普查人口为675,647人，是美国东北部人口第三多的城市，仅次于纽约和费城。

en.s: The Battle of Breitenfeld, 17 September 1631, took place during the Thirty Years' War outside Breitenfeld, Leipzig, in modern Saxony. In one of the most significant battles of the war, a combined Swedish-Saxon force defeated an army made up of Imperial and Catholic League troops. Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War began in June 1630 when nearly 18,000 soldiers under Gustavus Adolphus landed in Pomerania.

zh.s: 布赖滕费尔德战役于1631年9月17日在三十年战争期间爆发，地点在今德国萨克森州莱比锡附近的布赖滕费尔德。瑞典和萨克森联军击败了帝国军与天主教联盟军。这是三十年战争中最重要的战役之一。瑞典于1630年6月介入战争，当时古斯塔夫·阿道夫率领近18,000名士兵在波美拉尼亚登陆。

en.s: The Battle of Vilanova took place on 17 September 1658 during the Portuguese Restoration War near the Fort of São Luis de Gonzaga, located downstream from Tui on the southern bank of the Minho River. A Spanish army commanded by the Governor of Galicia, Rodrigo Pimentel, Marquis of Viana, entered Portuguese territory and confronted a Portuguese army led by João Rodrigues de Vasconcelos e Sousa, 2nd Count of Castelo Melhor.

zh.s: 维拉诺瓦战役于1658年9月17日在葡萄牙复国战争期间爆发，地点靠近圣路易斯·德·贡萨加堡。该堡位于图伊下游、米尼奥河南岸。加利西亚总督维亚纳侯爵罗德里戈·皮门特尔率领西班牙军队进入葡萄牙境内，与若昂·罗德里格斯·德·瓦斯孔塞洛斯·索萨率领的葡萄牙军队交战；后者是卡斯特洛梅利奥第二代伯爵。

en.s: The Battle of Dungeness or the Battle of Cape Dungeness (French: Bataille du cap Dungeness) (17 September 1666) was a naval battle that took place during the Second Anglo-Dutch War. A combined French and Dutch fleet under Job Forant encountered a larger English fleet commanded by Admiral Sir Thomas Allin, 1st Baronet. The English attacked and in poor visibility a series of encounters left several French and Dutch ships badly damaged.

zh.s: 邓杰内斯战役（又称邓杰内斯角海战，法语：Bataille du cap Dungeness）于1666年9月17日在第二次英荷战争期间爆发。约布·福朗指挥的法荷联合舰队遭遇托马斯·艾林爵士率领、规模更大的英国舰队。英军发动攻击，能见度不佳时双方多次交战，数艘法国和荷兰船只严重受损。

en.s: The siege of Fort St. Jean (September 17 – November 3, 1775 French: Siège du Fort Saint-Jean) was conducted by American Brigadier General Richard Montgomery on the town and fort of Saint-Jean, also called St. John, St. Johns, or St. John's, in the British province of Quebec during the American Revolutionary War. The siege lasted from September 17 to November 3, 1775.
en.n: American Revolutionary War: The invasion of Quebec by the Continental Army begins with the Siege of Fort St. Jean.

zh.s: 圣让堡围城战（法语：Siège du Fort Saint-Jean）由美国准将理查德·蒙哥马利指挥，于1775年9月17日至11月3日在魁北克省英属城镇圣让（又称圣约翰、圣约翰斯或圣约翰城）及其堡垒周边进行，是美国独立战争期间的一场围城战。大陆军于9月17日开始围攻圣让堡，这也标志着其入侵魁北克的行动开始。

en.t: The Presidio of San Francisco is founded in New Spain
en.s: The Presidio of San Francisco (originally, El Presidio Real de San Francisco or The Royal Fortress of Saint Francis) is a park and former U.S. Army post on the northern tip of the San Francisco Peninsula in San Francisco, California, and is part of the Golden Gate National Recreation Area. It had been a fortified location since September 17, 1776, when New Spain established the presidio to gain a foothold in Alta California and the San Francisco Bay.

zh.s: 旧金山要塞（原名El Presidio Real de San Francisco，即“圣方济各皇家要塞”）位于加利福尼亚州旧金山半岛北端，曾是美国陆军驻地，如今是金门国家游憩区的一部分。1776年9月17日，新西班牙当局在此建立要塞，以便在上加利福尼亚和旧金山湾地区站稳脚跟。

en.s: The Treaty of Fort Pitt, also known as the Treaty With the Delawares, the Delaware Treaty, or the Fourth Treaty of Pittsburgh, was signed on September 17, 1778; it was the first formal treaty between the new United States of America and any Native American groups, in this case the Lenape, called the Delaware by white settlers.

zh.s: 皮特堡条约又称《与特拉华人的条约》《特拉华条约》或《第四次匹兹堡条约》，于1778年9月17日签署。这是新成立的美利坚合众国与美洲原住民群体签订的第一份正式条约，对方是莱纳佩人；白人移民称他们为特拉华人。

en.s: The attack on German Flatts (September 17, 1778) was a raid on the frontier settlement of German Flatts, New York (which then also encompassed what is now Herkimer) during the American Revolutionary War. The attack was made by a mixed force of Loyalists and Haudenosaunee (Iroquois) under the overall command of Mohawk leader Joseph Brant, and resulted in the destruction of houses, barns, and crops, and the taking of livestock for the raiders' use.

zh.t: 德意志弗拉特斯袭击（1778年）
zh.s: 德意志弗拉特斯袭击是美国独立战争期间的一次边境突袭，于1778年9月17日发生在纽约州德意志弗拉特斯聚居点（当时范围还包括今赫基默地区）。莫霍克族领袖约瑟夫·布兰特统率效忠派和豪德诺索尼（易洛魁）组成的混合部队发动袭击，摧毁房屋、谷仓和农作物，并掠走牲畜供己方使用。

en.t: Signing of the United States Constitution
en.s: The Signing of the United States Constitution occurred on September 17, 1787, at Independence Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, when 39 delegates to the Constitutional Convention, representing 12 states (all but Rhode Island, which declined to send delegates), endorsed the Constitution created during the four-month-long convention. In addition to signatures, this endorsement, the Constitution's eschatocol, included a brief declaration that the delegates’ work has been successfully completed and that those whose signatures appear on it subscribe to the final document. Included are, a statement pronouncing the document's adoption by the states present, a formulaic dating of its adoption, along with the signatures of those endorsing it.

zh.s: 美国宪法于1787年9月17日在宾夕法尼亚州费城独立厅签署。制宪会议39名代表代表12个州认可了这份经过四个月会议制定的宪法；罗得岛州没有派代表。签署时还附有一段简短声明，说明代表们已完成工作，签名者认可最终文件，并声明与会各州采纳宪法。

en.t: Independence Hall in Philadelphia was the meeting place for the Constitutional Convention, which ratified the Constitution on September 17, 1787, which is now the longest-standing codified national constitution
en.s: Philadelphia ( FIL-ə-DEL-fee-ə), colloquially referred to as Philly, is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Pennsylvania and the sixth-most populous city in the United States. Its population was 1.60 million at the 2020 census and estimated at 1.57 million in 2025. The Philadelphia metropolitan area, also known as the Delaware Valley, is located in both the Mid-Atlantic and northeastern United States; home to 6.33 million residents, it is the nation's ninth-largest metropolitan area.

zh.t: 美国制宪会议在费城独立厅召开，并于1787年9月17日批准宪法
zh.s: 费城是美国宾夕法尼亚州人口最多的城市，也是全美人口第六多的城市。根据2020年人口普查，人口为160万；2025年估计为157万。费城都会区又称特拉华谷，位于美国中大西洋地区和东北部，人口633万，是全美第九大都会区。

en.s: Mimas is the seventh-largest natural satellite of Saturn. With a mean diameter of 396.4 kilometres or 246.3 miles, Mimas is the smallest astronomical body known to be roughly rounded in shape due to its own gravity. Mimas's low density, 1.15 g/cm3, indicates that it is composed mostly of water ice with only a small amount of rock, and study of Mimas's motion suggests that it may have a liquid ocean beneath its surface ice.

zh.s: 米玛斯是土星第七大天然卫星，平均直径396.4公里（246.3英里）。它是已知最小的天体中，因自身引力而呈近似球形的天体。米玛斯密度较低，仅为1.15克/立方厘米，表明其主要由水冰组成，只含少量岩石；对其运动的研究显示，冰层下可能存在液态海洋。

en.s: The Battle of Peyrestortes on 17 September 1793 saw soldiers of the First French Republic fighting troops of the Kingdom of Spain during the War of the Pyrenees. The French Army of the eastern Pyrenees, temporarily commanded by Eustache Charles d'Aoust defeated two divisions of the Army of Catalonia led by Juan de Courten and Jerónimo Girón-Moctezuma, Marquis de las Amarilas. This Spanish setback in an attempt to capture Perpignan marked the high point of their invasion of Roussillon. The Spanish army of Antonio Ricardos had occupied part of Rousillon and made an abortive attempt to seize the fortress of Perpignan in July.

zh.s: 1793年9月17日，第一次法兰西共和国军队与西班牙王国军队在比利牛斯战争期间爆发佩雷斯托尔特战役。临时由欧斯塔什·夏尔·达乌指挥的东比利牛斯军团击败了胡安·德·库尔滕和阿马里利亚斯侯爵赫罗尼莫·希龙-蒙特祖马率领的加泰罗尼亚军团两个师。西班牙军队此前占领鲁西永部分地区，并于7月试图攻占佩皮尼昂要塞但未成功；这次失利标志着其入侵鲁西永行动达到顶点后受挫。

en.s: The Battle of Krupczyce took place between the Russian Empire's armed forces under the command of Alexander Vasilyevich Suvorov and Kościuszko's Polish-Lithuanian rebels under Karol Józef Sierakowski east of Brest (near the Krupczyce Abbey), in present-day Chyzhewshchyna, Belarus, on September 17, 1794. It was part of the Kościuszko Uprising and ended with the defeat of the rebels.

zh.s: 克鲁普奇采战役于1794年9月17日在布列斯特以东、克鲁普奇采修道院附近爆发，地点在今白俄罗斯希日夫申纳。亚历山大·瓦西里耶维奇·苏沃洛夫指挥的俄罗斯帝国军队与卡罗尔·约瑟夫·谢拉科夫斯基率领的科希丘什科波兰立陶宛起义军交战。战役是科希丘什科起义的一部分，起义军战败。

en.s: The Treaty of Fredrikshamn, or the Treaty of Hamina, was a peace treaty concluded between Sweden and Imperial Russia on 17 September 1809. The treaty concluded the Finnish War and was signed in the Finnish town of Fredrikshamn (Hamina). Russia was represented by Nikolay Rumyantsev and David Alopaeus (Russian ambassador to Stockholm), while Sweden by Infantry General Kurt von Stedingk (former Swedish ambassador to Saint Petersburg) and Colonel Anders Fredrik Skjöldebrand.

zh.s: 弗雷德里克斯港条约（又称哈米纳条约）是瑞典与俄罗斯帝国于1809年9月17日缔结的和平条约，结束了芬兰战争。条约在芬兰的弗雷德里克斯港（今哈米纳）签署。俄罗斯代表是尼古拉·鲁缅采夫和俄罗斯驻斯德哥尔摩大使大卫·阿洛佩乌斯；瑞典代表是步兵将军库尔特·冯·施泰丁克（前瑞典驻圣彼得堡大使）和安德斯·弗雷德里克·谢尔德布兰德上校。

en.s: The Finnish War was fought between the Kingdom of Sweden and the Russian Empire from 21 February 1808 to 17 September 1809 as part of the Napoleonic Wars. As a result of the war, the eastern third of Sweden was established as the autonomous Grand Duchy of Finland within the Russian Empire.

en.s: The Second Battle of Kulm or the Battle of Teplitz was fought on 17 September 1813 heights immediately above Kulm, by a Coalition army commanded by the Austrian field marshal, Prince of Schwarzenberg, and a French army under the command of the Emperor Napoleon. It resulted in an Austrian victory.

zh.s: 第二次库尔姆战役（又称特普利采战役）于1813年9月17日在库尔姆上方的高地爆发。施瓦岑贝格亲王率领奥地利元帅指挥的联军，对阵拿破仑皇帝统率的法军。战役以奥军获胜告终。

en.s: The 1818 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on September 17, 1818, in order to elect the first lieutenant governor of Illinois upon Illinois acquiring statehood on December 3, 1818. Democratic-Republican candidate Pierre Menard defeated fellow Democratic-Republican candidates William L. Reynolds and Edward N. Cullom.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1818年9月17日举行副州长选举，选出该州首任副州长。伊利诺伊州于同年12月3日加入美国。民主共和党候选人皮埃尔·梅纳尔击败同党候选人威廉·L.雷诺兹和爱德华·N.卡勒姆。

en.s: The siege of Pamplona (French: siège de Pampelune, Spanish: asedio de Pamplona) took place in 1823 during the French invasion of Spain. The city of Pamplona in Navarre was besieged by the French Army and successfully taken. It was one of the more notable actions of the campaign along with the Battle of Trocadero.

en.s: The Battle of Siluk was an engagement at the closing stages of the Java War between rebel forces of Prince Diponegoro, commanded by Sentot Prawirodirdjo, and Dutch colonial forces on 17 September 1829. Dutch forces, pursuing Diponegoro, attempted to surround his force at the village of Siluk, and after a battle, scattered the remnants of the rebel force while failing to capture Diponegoro.

zh.s: 西卢克战役发生于1829年9月17日爪哇战争末期，交战双方是森托特·普拉维罗迪尔乔指挥的迪波内戈罗王子起义军和荷兰殖民军。荷兰军追击迪波内戈罗，试图在西卢克村包围其部队。交战后，荷军击散了起义军残部，但未能抓获迪波内戈罗。

en.s: The Dawson massacre, also called the Dawson expedition, was an incident in which 36 Texian militiamen were killed by Mexican soldiers on September 17, 1842 near San Antonio de Bexar (now the U.S. city of San Antonio, Texas). The event occurred during the Battle of Salado Creek, which ended with a Texan victory. This was among numerous armed conflicts over the area between the Rio Grande and Nueces rivers, which the Republic of Texas tried to control after achieving independence in 1836.

zh.s: 道森惨案（又称道森远征）发生于1842年9月17日，地点在贝克萨尔附近（今美国德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥）。墨西哥士兵杀害了36名德克萨斯民兵。当时，萨拉多溪战役正在进行，最终德克萨斯人获胜。这是格兰德河与努埃塞斯河之间地区发生的多次武装冲突之一。德克萨斯共和国于1836年独立后试图控制该地区。

en.s: The Battle of the Salado was a decisive engagement in 1842 which repulsed the final Mexican invasion of the Republic of Texas. Colonel Mathew Caldwell of the Texas Rangers led just over 200 militia against an army of 1,600 Mexican Army soldiers and Cherokee warriors, and defeated them outside of San Antonio de Bexar along Salado Creek.

zh.s: 萨拉多溪战役是1842年的一场决定性战斗，击退了墨西哥对德克萨斯共和国的最后一次入侵。马修·考德威尔上校率领200多名德克萨斯游骑兵和民兵，在贝克萨尔圣安东尼奥城外的萨拉多溪附近击败了由1,600名墨西哥军人和切罗基战士组成的军队。

en.s: The Battle of Estrelleta (Spanish: Batalla de la Esrelleta) was a major battle of the Dominican War of Independence and was fought on September 17, 1845, at the site of Estrelleta, near Las Matas de Farfán, San Juan Province. A force of Dominican troops, a portion of the Army of the South, led by General Antonio Duvergé, defeated an outnumbering force of the Haitian Army led by General Jean-Louis Pierrot.

zh.s: 埃斯特雷列塔战役是多米尼加独立战争中的一场重要战役，于1845年9月17日在圣胡安省法尔凡马塔斯附近的埃斯特雷列塔发生。安东尼奥·杜维尔热将军率领部分多米尼加南方军，击败了人数更多、由让-路易·皮埃罗将军率领的海地军队。

en.s: The Battle of Pavón was a key battle of the Argentine civil wars. It was fought in Pavón in Santa Fé Province, Argentina, on September 17, 1861, between the Army of the State of Buenos Aires, commanded by Bartolomé Mitre, and the Army of Republic of the Argentine Confederation commanded by Justo José de Urquiza. The withdrawal of Urquiza left the field to Mitre. It led to the dissolution of the national government and the reincorporation of Buenos Aires Province into the Argentine Republic as a dominant member of the nation.

zh.s: 帕翁战役是阿根廷内战中的一场关键战役，于1861年9月17日在阿根廷圣菲省帕翁爆发。巴托洛梅·米特雷指挥的布宜诺斯艾利斯州军队与胡斯托·何塞·德·乌尔基萨指挥的阿根廷邦联军队交战。乌尔基萨撤兵后，战场落入米特雷手中。此战导致国家政府解散，布宜诺斯艾利斯省重新并入阿根廷共和国，并成为国家中的主导力量。

en.s: The action at Blue Mills Landing, also known as the Battle of Liberty, was a battle of the American Civil War that took place on September 17, 1861, in Clay County, Missouri. Union forces unsuccessfully attempted to prevent pro-Southern Missouri State Guards from northwestern Missouri from crossing the Missouri River near the confluence with the Blue River to reinforce Sterling Price at Lexington.

zh.s: 蓝磨坊渡口战斗（又称自由镇战役）是美国内战期间的一场战斗，于1861年9月17日在密苏里州克莱县发生。联邦军试图阻止来自密苏里州西北部、支持南方的州民兵渡过密苏里河，在河流与蓝河交汇处附近增援莱克星顿的斯特林·普赖斯，但未能成功。

en.s: The Battle of Antietam /ænˈtiːtəm/, also known as the Battle of Sharpsburg, particularly in the South, was fought on September 17, 1862, near Sharpsburg, Maryland and Antietam Creek as part of the Maryland Campaign. It was the first Field army-level engagement in the Eastern Theater of the American Civil War to take place on Union soil. It is the bloodiest single-day battle in American history, with a combined tally of 22,717 dead, wounded, or missing. After pursuing the Confederate general Robert E. Lee into Maryland, Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan of the Union Army launched attacks against Lee's army, in defensive positions behind Antietam Creek.

zh.s: 安提特姆战役（南方常称沙普斯堡战役）于1862年9月17日在马里兰州沙普斯堡和安提特姆溪附近爆发，是马里兰会战的一部分。这是美国内战东部战区首次在联邦领土上进行的大规模野战军交战，也是美国历史上伤亡最惨重的单日战役，死伤及失踪人数合计22,717人。联邦军少将乔治·B.麦克莱伦追击南军将领罗伯特·E.李进入马里兰州后，向在安提特姆溪后方占据防御阵地的南军发动进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Munfordville (also known as the Battle of Green River) was an engagement in Munfordville, Kentucky during the American Civil War. Victory there allowed the Confederates to temporarily strengthen their hold on the region and impair Union supply lines.

en.t: American Civil War: The Allegheny Arsenal explosion in Lawrenceville, Pennsylvania results in the single largest civilian disaster during the war
en.s: The Allegheny Arsenal, established in 1814, was an important supply and manufacturing center for the Union Army during the American Civil War, and the site of the single largest civilian disaster during the war. It was located in the community of Lawrenceville, Pennsylvania, which was annexed by the city of Pittsburgh in 1868.

zh.t: 美国内战：阿勒格尼兵工厂爆炸，成为战争期间伤亡最惨重的平民灾难
zh.s: 阿勒格尼兵工厂建于1814年，是美国内战期间联邦军的重要补给和制造中心，也是战争期间伤亡最惨重的平民灾难发生地。兵工厂位于宾夕法尼亚州劳伦斯维尔社区，该地于1868年并入匹兹堡市。

en.s: The 1878 Canadian federal election was held on September 17, 1878, to elect members of the House of Commons of the 4th Parliament of Canada. It resulted in the end of Prime Minister Alexander Mackenzie's Liberal government after only one term in office. Canada suffered an economic depression during Mackenzie's term, and his party was punished by voters for it.

zh.s: 加拿大于1878年9月17日举行联邦大选，选出第4届加拿大议会众议院议员。选举后，亚历山大·麦肯齐领导的自由党政府结束了仅一届任期。加拿大当时遭遇经济萧条，选民因此惩罚执政党。

en.s: The 1878 Nova Scotia general election was held on 17 September 1878 to elect members of the 27th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Liberal-Conservative Party.

en.s: The Battle of the Yalu River (simplified Chinese: 黄海海战; traditional Chinese: 黃海海戰; pinyin: Huáng Hǎi Hǎizhàn; Japanese: 黄海海戦, romanized: Kōkai-kaisen; lit. 'Naval Battle of the Yellow Sea') was the largest naval engagement of the First Sino-Japanese War, and took place on 17 September 1894, the day after the Japanese victory at the land Battle of Pyongyang. The Imperial Japanese Navy defeated the Chinese Beiyang Fleet.

zh.s: 鸭绿江海战（中文又称黄海海战；日语：黄海海戦，罗马字转写：Kōkai-kaisen，意为“黄海海战”）是甲午战争中规模最大的一场海战，于1894年9月17日爆发，距日军在平壤陆战取胜仅一天。日本帝国海军击败了中国北洋舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Mabitac was an engagement in the Philippine-American War, when on September 17, 1900, Filipinos under General Juan Cailles defeated an American force commanded by Colonel Benjamin F. Cheatham, Jr. Mabitac was linked to the garrison town of Siniloan by a causeway which, on the day of the battle, was flooded with water (in many parts waist-deep). The water in the flanking rice fields was even deeper, making it impossible to properly deploy off the narrow road. Trenches occupied by Filipinos under Cailles cut across this causeway, blocking the path into Mabitac.

zh.s: 马比塔克战役是美菲战争期间的一场交战。1900年9月17日，胡安·凯列斯将军率领的菲律宾军队击败了本杰明·F.奇瑟姆二世上校指挥的美军。马比塔克通过一条堤道与驻军城镇西尼洛安相连，战斗当天堤道被水淹没，许多地方水深及腰，旁边稻田里的水更深，美军难以离开狭窄道路展开队形。凯列斯率领的菲律宾军队在堤道上挖设战壕，挡住了通往马比塔克的道路。

en.s: The Battle of Elands River took place near the Elands River Poort mountain pass on 17 September 1901 during the Second Boer War. During the battle a Boer raiding force under Jan Smuts destroyed a British cavalry squadron led by Captain Sandeman, a cousin of Winston Churchill, on the Modderfontein farm. This battle is therefore also known as the Battle of Modderfontein.

zh.s: 埃兰兹河战役于1901年9月17日在第二次布尔战争期间爆发，地点靠近埃兰兹河峡谷山口。扬·史末资率领的布尔突袭部队在莫德方丹农场击溃了桑德曼上尉指挥的英军骑兵中队。桑德曼是温斯顿·丘吉尔的表亲。这场战役也称莫德方丹战役。

en.s: In the Battle of Blood River Poort or Scheeper's Nek on 17 September 1901 a Boer commando led by Louis Botha crushed a British force commanded by Major Hubert Gough during the Second Boer War.

zh.s: 血河渡口战役（又称谢珀斯内克战役）于1901年9月17日第二次布尔战争期间爆发。路易·博塔指挥的布尔突击队击溃了休伯特·高夫少校率领的英军。

en.s: The first Iranian legislative election held on 17 September 1906 after the Iranian Constitutional Revolution by a sentence from Mozaffar ad-Din Shah Qajar. First, on 27 September 1906, Mirza Nasrullah Khan was elected as the first elected Prime Minister of Iran; but before he could officially take office, he was dismissed by the Majlis again, and then the Majlis elected Ali Asghar Atabak as Prime Minister, but since Atabak was abroad, a provisional government was formed headed by Soltan-Ali Vazir-e Afkham.

zh.s: 伊朗宪政革命后，卡扎尔王朝国王穆扎法尔丁·沙阿颁令，首次伊朗议会选举于1906年9月17日举行。9月27日，米尔扎·纳斯鲁拉汗当选首任民选首相，但在正式就职前又被议会罢免。随后议会选举阿里·阿斯加尔·阿塔巴克为首相；由于阿塔巴克当时身在国外，苏尔坦-阿里·瓦齐尔-阿夫哈姆领导了临时政府。

en.t: 1907 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1907 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on September 17, 1907, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Oklahoma, which was set to be admitted to the Union on November 16, 1907. Members were elected to short terms that would last the remainder of the 60th Congress. Upon statehood, Oklahoma was delegated five congressional districts, which were held by four Democratic representatives and one Republican.

zh.t: 1907年俄克拉何马州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于1907年9月17日举行选举，选出该州五名美国众议员。俄克拉何马州当时将在11月16日加入联邦，当选议员的短期任期将持续到第60届国会结束。该州加入联邦后划分为五个国会选区，由四名民主党人和一名共和党人担任议员。

en.s: The 1907 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on September 17, 1907, and was the inaugural race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Charles N. Haskell defeated Republican Frank Frantz, the territorial governor. Also on the ballot was C. C. Ross of the Socialist Party. Oklahoma joined the Union as the 46th state on November 16, 1907. Haskell and all other new state officers elected at this general election took office on that date.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于1907年9月17日举行首次州长选举。民主党人查尔斯·N.哈斯克尔击败共和党人、时任领地总督弗兰克·弗兰茨。社会主义党候选人C. C.罗斯也参加了选举。俄克拉何马州于1907年11月16日成为美国第46个州，哈斯克尔及其他新州官员也在当天就职。

en.s: The siege of Toma was a bloodless action during the First World War on the island of New Pomerania (now New Britain) between 14 and 17 September 1914 as part of the occupation of German New Guinea by the Australian Naval and Military Expeditionary Force (AN&MEF).

en.s: The Race to the Sea (French: Course à la mer; German: Wettlauf zum Meer, Dutch: Race naar de Zee) took place from 17 September to 19 October 1914 during the First World War, after the Battle of the Frontiers (7 August – 13 September) and the German advance into France. en.t: Andrew Fisher, who in his previous term as premier oversaw a period of reform unmatched in the Commonwealth until the 1940s, became Prime Minister of Australia for the third time
en.s: Andrew Fisher (29 August 1862 – 22 October 1928) was the fifth prime minister of Australia from 1908 to 1909, from 1910 to 1913 and from 1914 to 1915. zh.t: 安德鲁·费舍尔第三次出任澳大利亚总理
zh.s: 安德鲁·费舍尔（1862年8月29日—1928年10月22日）曾三度担任澳大利亚总理：1908年至1909年、1910年至1913年以及1914年至1915年。他是澳大利亚工党领袖，尤其以带领该党在1910年联邦大选中首次获胜并组建首个多数政府而闻名。

en.s: The Seventh Battle of the Isonzo was fought from 14 to 17 September 1916 between the armies of the Kingdom of Italy and those of Austria-Hungary. It followed the Italian successes during the Trentino Offensive and the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo in the spring of 1916.

en.s: The National Football League (NFL) is a professional American football league in the United States. Composed of 32 teams, it is divided equally between the American Football Conference (AFC) and the National Football Conference (NFC). zh.s: 美国国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）是美国职业美式橄榄球联盟，现有32支球队，分为美联和国联两个分区，是美国和加拿大主要职业体育联盟之一，也是世界最高水平的美式橄榄球联赛。1920年，联盟在俄亥俄州坎顿成立，最初名为美国职业橄榄球协会。

en.t: The Border Protection Corps is established in the Second Polish Republic for the defence of the eastern border against armed Soviet raids and local bandits
en.s: The Border Protection Corps (Polish: Korpus Ochrony Pogranicza, KOP) was a military formation of the Second Polish Republic that was created in 1924 to defend the country's eastern borders against armed Soviet incursions and local bandits. Other borders were under the jurisdiction of a separate, regular Border Guard state security agency. Though the corps was part of the Polish Army, it was commanded directly by the Ministry of Internal Affairs rather than the Ministry of Military Affairs.

zh.t: 波兰边防军成立，负责防卫波兰第二共和国东部边境
zh.s: 边防军（波兰语：Korpus Ochrony Pogranicza，简称KOP）是波兰第二共和国于1924年组建的一支军事力量，负责防御东部边境，抵御苏联武装入侵和当地匪徒。其他边境地区则由独立的常规国家安全机构边防卫队负责。边防军虽隶属波兰陆军，却由内政部直接指挥，而非军事部。

en.s: The Battle of al-Musayfirah (also spelled Battle of Messifre or Battle of Moussiefre) was one of the major military engagements between Druze rebels and the French Army on 17 September 1925, during the early stage of the Great Syrian Revolt, which continued on until 1927. After initial rebel victories against French forces at al-Kafr and then al-Mazraa, an advance guard of the French Army, then under the leadership of General Maurice Gamelin, was dispatched to the village of al-Musayfirah on 15 September. After clearing the village of its inhabitants, they set up fortifications in preparation for an assault on al-Suwayda.

zh.s: 穆赛菲拉战役（又称梅西弗尔战役或穆西弗雷战役）是1925年9月17日发生的一场重要战事，交战双方为德鲁兹起义军和法国军队，战事发生在大叙利亚起义初期。起义持续到1927年。起义军先后在卡夫尔和马兹拉取得初胜后，毛里斯·加梅兰将军指挥的法军先遣队于9月15日被派往穆赛菲拉村。他们清空村庄居民，并修筑防御工事，为进攻苏韦达做准备。

en.s: The Bombardment of Chefchaouen was an aerial bombardment of Chefchaouen, Morocco carried out in the middle of the Rif War by a rogue American squadron in the service of the French colonial empire, the Escadrille Cherifienne, on September 17, 1925. The bombing of Chefchaouen, in which civilians were largely the victims, was one of the first ever bombings of civilians by airplane in history.

en.s: The Battle of Brześć Litewski (also known as the Siege of Brześć, Battle of Brest-Litovsk or simply Battle of Brześć) was a World War II battle involving German and Polish forces that took place between 14 and 17 September 1939, near the town of Brześć Litewski (now Brest, Belarus). Subsequent military operations lasted for the following 20 days and ended on 6 October 1939 with the two-way division and annexation of the entire territory of the Second Polish Republic by Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 苏联入侵波兰是苏联在未正式宣战的情况下发动的一场军事冲突。1939年9月17日，苏联从东面入侵波兰；此前16天，纳粹德国已从西面入侵。此后的军事行动持续20天，至10月6日结束，纳粹德国和苏联分割并吞并了波兰第二共和国全部领土。

en.s: Operation Sea Lion, also written as Operation Sealion (German: Unternehmen Seelöwe), was Nazi Germany's code name for their planned invasion of the United Kingdom. It was to have taken place during the Battle of Britain, nine months after the start of the Second World War. Following the armistice with France after the Battle of France, Adolf Hitler, the German Führer and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, hoped the British government would accept his offer to end the state of war between the two. He considered invasion to be a last resort, to be used only if all other options had failed. As a precondition for the invasion of Britain, Hitler demanded both air and naval superiority over the English Channel and the proposed landing sites. The German forces achieved neither at any point of the war. Further, both the German High Command and Hitler himself held serious doubts about the prospects for success. Nevertheless, both the German Army and Navy undertook major preparations for an invasion. These included training troops, developing specialised weapons and equipment, modifying transport vessels and the collection of a large number of river barges and transport ships on the Channel coast. However, in light of mounting Luftwaffe losses in the Battle of Britain and the absence of any sign that the Royal Air Force had been defeated, Hitler postponed Sea Lion indefinitely on 17 September 1940.

zh.t: 海狮行动被无限期推迟
zh.s: 海狮行动（德语：Unternehmen Seelöwe，也写作Sealion）是纳粹德国为计划入侵英国设定的代号。行动原计划在不列颠之战期间进行，即第二次世界大战爆发九个月后。法国战役后法国与德国停战，德国元首兼武装部队最高统帅阿道夫·希特勒希望英国政府接受结束战争的提议；他把入侵视为其他办法都失败后的最后选择。德国要求先取得英吉利海峡和拟登陆地点的制空权与制海权，但始终未能做到。德国陆军和海军仍进行了大规模准备，包括训练部队、研制专用武器装备、改装运输船，并在海峡沿岸集中大量驳船和运输船。1940年9月17日，由于德国空军在不列颠之战中损失不断增加，且没有迹象表明英国皇家空军已被击败，希特勒将海狮行动无限期推迟。

en.s: The Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran, also known as the Anglo-Soviet invasion of Persia or the Allied invasion of Iran, was the joint invasion of the officially neutral Imperial State of Iran by the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union in August 1941. The two powers announced that they would stay until six months after the end of the war with their mutual enemy, Nazi Germany (World War II), which turned out to be 2 March 1946.

zh.s: 英苏入侵伊朗又称英苏入侵波斯或盟军入侵伊朗，是英国和苏联于1941年8月联合入侵官方中立的伊朗帝国。两国宣布，战争结束六个月后才会撤军；其共同敌人是纳粹德国，这场战争最终于1946年3月2日结束。

en.s: Operation Gearbox (30 June – 17 September 1942) was a joint Norwegian and British operation to occupy the Arctic island of Spitsbergen during the Second World War. It superseded Operation Fritham, an expedition in May, to secure the coal mines on Spitsbergen, the main island of the Svalbard Archipelago which had failed when attacked by four German Focke-Wulf Fw 200 Condor reconnaissance bombers.

Planned under the name Top Hat, it was supported by the deception plan Operation Boardman.

en.s: The Battle of San Marino was an engagement on 17–20 September 1944 during the Italian Campaign of the Second World War, in which German Army forces occupied the neutral Republic of San Marino, and were then attacked by Allied forces. It is also sometimes known as the Battle of Monte Pulito. San Marino had declared its neutrality earlier in the war, and had remained broadly unaffected by events in Europe until 1944, when Allied forces had advanced a sizable distance up the Italian Peninsula.

en.s: Folke Bernadotte, Count of Wisborg (Swedish: [fɔ̂l.kɛ̂ bæɳaˈdɔtː]; 2 January 1895 – 17 September 1948) was a Swedish nobleman and diplomat. In World War II, he negotiated the release of about 450 Danish Jews and 30,550 non-Jewish prisoners of many nations from the Nazi German Theresienstadt Ghetto. They were released on 14 April 1945. In 1945 he received a German surrender offer from Heinrich Himmler, though the offer was ultimately rejected by the allies.

zh.s: 维斯堡伯爵福尔克·贝尔纳多特（瑞典语：[fɔ̂l.kɛ̂ bæɳaˈdɔtː]；1895年1月2日—1948年9月17日）是瑞典贵族和外交官。第二次世界大战期间，他与纳粹德国谈判，促成约450名丹麦犹太人和30,550名其他国家的非犹太囚犯从特雷西恩施塔特集中营获释，释放日期为1945年4月14日。1945年，他收到海因里希·希姆莱提出的德国投降方案，但盟军最终拒绝了该提议。

All 37 on board were killed in the accident. Flight 706 began its day in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and was scheduled to stop at Chicago before travelling to Tampa, Fort Lauderdale, and Miami, Florida.

zh.t: 西北东方航空706号班机空难
zh.s: 西北东方航空706号班机是一架注册编号为N137US的洛克希德L-188“伊莱克特拉”客机，于1961年9月17日在芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场起飞时坠毁，机上37人全部遇难。当天，706号班机从威斯康星州密尔沃基出发，原定在芝加哥经停，然后飞往佛罗里达州坦帕、劳德代尔堡和迈阿密。

en.s: A federal election was held in West Germany on 17 September 1961 to elect the members of the fourth Bundestag. The CDU/CSU remained the largest faction, winning 242 of the 499 seats. However, the loss of its majority and the All-German Party losing all its seats led to the CDU having to negotiate a coalition with the long-term junior coalition partner, the Free Democratic Party, leading to a demand for long-term chancellor Konrad Adenauer to leave office in 1963, halfway through his term.

zh.s: 西德于1961年9月17日举行联邦大选，选出第四届联邦议院议员。基民盟／基社盟仍是最大党团，赢得499席中的242席。但该联盟失去多数席位，全德人民党也失去全部席位，因此基民盟不得不与长期的小党执政伙伴自由民主党谈判组阁。这也促使外界要求长期执政的总理康拉德·阿登纳在1963年、任期过半时下台。

en.t: The world's first retractable roof stadium, the Civic Arena, opens in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
en.s: The Civic Arena, formerly the Civic Auditorium and later Mellon Arena, was a multi-purpose arena located in Downtown Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It primarily served as the home to the Pittsburgh Penguins, the city's National Hockey League (NHL) franchise, from 1967 to 2010. Constructed in 1961 for use by the Pittsburgh Civic Light Opera (CLO), it was the brainchild of department store owner Edgar J. Kaufmann.

zh.t: 世界首座可伸缩屋顶体育场匹兹堡市政体育馆开放
zh.s: 市政体育馆曾称市政礼堂，后称梅隆体育馆，是位于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市中心的一座多用途场馆。1967年至2010年间，它主要是匹兹堡企鹅队的主场。该馆于1961年为匹兹堡市民轻歌剧团建造，构想者是百货公司老板埃德加·J·考夫曼。

en.s: The Siege of Jadotville ([ʒa.do.vil]) was a major battle during the Congo Crisis, that began on 13 September 1961 and lasted for five days. A small contingent of the Irish Army's 35th Battalion serving under the United Nations Operation in the Congo (ONUC), designated "A" Company, was besieged at the UN base near the mining town of Jadotville (modern-day Likasi) by Katangese forces loyal to the secessionist State of Katanga.

en.s: The Aden Airport attack was a grenade attack which took place on 17 September 1965 and resulted in the injury of nine people. The United Kingdom accused the attackers of being "externally controlled", referring to Gamal Abdel Nasser's Republic of Egypt. The attack prompted the UK to suspend the constitution of the Aden Protectorate on 25 September, in an attempt to put an end to the violence.

en.s: The Battle of Chawinda was a major engagement between Pakistan and India during the Indo-Pakistani war of 1965 as part of the Sialkot campaign. It is well known as being one of the largest tank battles in history since the Battle of Kursk, which was fought between the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany in World War II.

zh.s: 查温达战役是1965年印巴战争期间巴基斯坦与印度之间的一场重要战役，也是西阿尔科特战役的一部分。自第二次世界大战中苏联与纳粹德国进行的库尔斯克战役以来，这场战斗被认为是历史上规模最大的坦克战之一。

en.s: The 1967 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the 36th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1967 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.s: The 1969 Israel Super Cup was the sixth Israel Super Cup, an annual Israeli football match played between the winners of the previous season's Top Division and Israel State Cup, and the first time the competition was played under the IFA. en.s: The Camp David Accords were a pair of political agreements signed by Egyptian president Anwar Sadat and Israeli prime minister Menachem Begin on 17 September 1978, following twelve days of secret negotiations at Camp David, the country retreat of the president of the United States in Maryland. zh.s: 埃及总统安瓦尔·萨达特和以色列总理梅纳赫姆·贝京于1978年9月17日签署两项戴维营协议。两人此前在美国总统位于马里兰州的戴维营度假地进行了12天秘密谈判。两项框架协议在白宫签署，由总统吉米·卡特见证。

en.s: Solidarity (Polish: „Solidarność”, pronounced [sɔliˈdarnɔɕt͡ɕ] ), full name Independent Self-Governing Trade Union "Solidarity" (Niezależny Samorządny Związek Zawodowy „Solidarność” [ɲɛzaˈlɛʐnɨ samɔˈʐɔndnɨ ˈzvjɔ̃zɛɡ zavɔˈdɔvɨ sɔliˈdarnɔɕt͡ɕ], abbreviated NSZZ „Solidarność”), is a Polish trade union founded in August 1980 at the Lenin Shipyard in Gdańsk, Poland. zh.s: 团结工会（波兰语：„Solidarność”），全名“独立自治工会团结工会”（Niezależny Samorządny Związek Zawodowy „Solidarność”；简称NSZZ „Solidarność”），是波兰工会，1980年8月在波兰格但斯克列宁造船厂成立。此后，它成为华沙条约组织国家中首个获国家承认的独立工会。

en.s: Anastasio "Tachito" Somoza Debayle (Spanish: [anasˈtasjo soˈmosa ðeˈβajle]; 5 December 1925 – 17 September 1980) was a Nicaraguan politician, military officer, hydraulic engineer, and dictator who served as the 53rd President of Nicaragua from 1967 to 1972 and again from 1974 until his fall in 1979. As head of the National Guard, he was de facto ruler of the country between 1967 and 1979, even during the period when he was not the de jure ruler.

zh.t: 阿纳斯塔西奥·索摩查·德瓦伊莱逝世
zh.s: 阿纳斯塔西奥·“塔奇托”·索摩查·德瓦伊莱（西班牙语：Anastasio Somoza Debayle；1925年12月5日—1980年9月17日）是尼加拉瓜政治家、军官、水利工程师和独裁者。他于1967年至1972年以及1974年至1979年担任尼加拉瓜第53任总统；作为国民警卫队负责人，他在1967年至1979年间实际上统治着尼加拉瓜，即使有些时期并未依法担任国家元首。

en.s: The EMLL 49th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Empresa Mexicana de Lucha Libre (EMLL) that took place on September 17, 1982 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the 49th anniversary of EMLL, which would become the oldest professional wrestling promotion in the world. The Anniversary show is EMLL's biggest show of the year, their Super Bowl event.

zh.s: EMLL第49届周年纪念秀是墨西哥摔角公司EMLL举办的一场大型职业摔角赛事，于1982年9月17日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行。此次活动纪念EMLL成立49周年。EMLL后来成为世界上历史最悠久的职业摔角推广公司。周年纪念秀是EMLL每年规模最大的赛事，相当于他们的“超级碗”。

en.s: Aniversario is a professional wrestling card that is held annually by Puerto Rican promotion World Wrestling Council (WWC) to commemorate its anniversary. Various WWC championships are defending at the event, and the 1986 event featured two defenses of the National Wrestling Alliance's NWA World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: 周年纪念赛是波多黎各世界摔角理事会（WWC）每年举办的职业摔角赛事，用于庆祝联盟成立。首场赛事于1983年举行，纪念WWC于1973年成立十周年。赛事中会捍卫WWC的多个冠军头衔；1986年赛事还进行了两场国家摔角联盟（NWA）世界重量级冠军卫冕赛。

en.s: The 1986 NSL Cup final was the final match of the 1986 NSL Cup, the tenth season of the National Soccer League Cup. As winners Sydney City qualified for the Oceania Cup Winners' Cup.

zh.s: 1986年国家足球联赛杯决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛，也是国家足球联赛杯第10个赛季的决赛。比赛于1986年9月17日在阿德莱德的欣德马什体育场举行，由阿德莱德希腊人队对阵悉尼城队。悉尼城以3比2获胜，首次夺得联赛杯，并因此获得参加大洋洲优胜者杯的资格。

zh.s: 1988年夏季奥运会于1988年9月17日至10月2日在韩国首尔举行，正式名称为第24届奥林匹克运动会，官方品牌名为“首尔1988”。共有159个国家和地区派出8,391名运动员参赛，其中男子6,197人、女子2,194人。赛事共设237个项目，有27,221名志愿者参与筹备。

en.t: An Iranian Kurdish leader and his two joiners are assassinated by political militants in Berlin
en.s: In the Mykonos restaurant assassinations (Persian: ترور رستوران میکونوس, Sorani Kurdish: تێرۆری میکۆنۆس; also the "Mykonos Incident"), Iranian-Kurdish opposition leaders Sadegh Sharafkandi, Fattah Abdoli, Homayoun Ardalan and their translator Nouri Dehkordi, were assassinated at the Mykonos Greek restaurant in Berlin, Germany on 17 September 1992. zh.s: 米科诺斯餐厅暗杀案（波斯语：ترور رستوران میکونوس，索拉尼库尔德语：تێرۆری میکۆنۆس，又称“米科诺斯事件”）于1992年9月17日在德国柏林发生。伊朗库尔德反对派领导人萨德格·谢拉夫坎迪、法塔赫·阿卜杜利、霍马雍·阿尔达兰及其翻译努里·德赫科尔迪在米科诺斯希腊餐厅遭暗杀。事件发生在库尔德斯坦民主党伊朗支部的武装起义期间，也是伊朗库尔德分离主义运动的一部分。

en.s: The 1995 Hong Kong Legislative Council election for members of the Legislative Council of Hong Kong (LegCo) was held on 17 September 1995. It was the last and the first fully elected legislative election in the colonial period before transferring Hong Kong's sovereignty to China two years later. The elections returned 20 members from directly elected geographical constituencies, 30 members from indirectly elected functional constituencies, and 10 members from elections committee constituency who were elected by all District Board members. Due to Governor Chris Patten's constitutional reforms, which were strongly opposed by the Beijing government, the nine newly created functional constituencies enfranchised around 2.7 million new voters.

en.s: The 2005 New Zealand general election on Saturday 17 September 2005 determined the membership of the 48th New Zealand Parliament. One hundred and twenty-one MPs were elected to the New Zealand House of Representatives: 69 from single-member electorates, including one overhang seat, and 52 from party lists (one extra due to the overhang). No party won a majority, but the Labour Party of Prime Minister Helen Clark secured two more seats than nearest rival, the National Party of Dr Don Brash. With the exception of the newly formed Māori Party, which took four Māori seats from Labour, most of the other parties polled lower than in the previous election, losing votes and seats.

en.s: A general election was held in Sweden on 17 September 2006, to elect members to the Riksdag, the Swedish national legislature. All 349 seats were up for election: 310 fixed seats in 29 constituencies and 39 adjustment seats, used to ensure that parties have representation in the Riksdag proportional to their share of the national vote. The electoral system used was semi-open list proportional representation using the Sainte-Laguë method of allocating seats. Elections for County and Municipal councils were also held on the same day. Fredrik Reinfeldt from the Moderate Party was able to form a majority government together with the Centre Party, Liberal People's Party and the Christian Democrats following the election.

en.s: The 2016 League of Ireland Cup final was the final match of the 2016 League of Ireland Cup, played between Limerick and defending champions St Patrick's Athletic. The match was played on 17 September 2016 at 5.30 pm. Limerick's route to the final involved them beating fellow First Division side Cobh Ramblers, before beating Premier Division sides Wexford Youths, Galway United and Derry City.

zh.s: 2016年爱尔兰联赛杯决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛，由利默里克队对阵卫冕冠军圣帕特里克竞技队。比赛于2016年9月17日17:30举行。利默里克晋级决赛途中先后击败同属甲级联赛的科布漫步者队，以及顶级联赛球队韦克斯福德青年队、戈尔韦联队和德里城队。

en.s: There was a by-election in the Pakistani parliamentary constituency of NA-120 on 17 September 2017, following the decision given by the Supreme Court of Pakistan to disqualify Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif from public office. PML (N) candidate Kulsoom Nawaz Sharif secured 61,745 votes and defeated Yasmin Rashid of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦议会NA-120选区于2017年9月17日举行补选。此前，巴基斯坦最高法院裁定取消总理纳瓦兹·谢里夫的公职资格。巴基斯坦穆斯林联盟（谢里夫派）候选人库尔苏姆·纳瓦兹·谢里夫获得61,745票，击败正义运动党候选人亚斯敏·拉希德。

en.s: The Swedish Church Assembly elections were held on 17 September 2017. All 249 seats in the General Synod of the Church of Sweden were up for election, as well as local governing bodies. In church elections in Sweden all members of the Church of Sweden over the age of 16 may vote. It takes through proportional representation by lists presented by nominating groups, many of which are political parties or affiliated with political parties.

zh.s: 瑞典教会大会选举于2017年9月17日举行。瑞典教会总议会的249个席位以及地方管理机构席位均进行改选。瑞典教会年满16岁的成员都有投票权。选举采用比例代表制，候选名单由提名团体提出，其中许多团体是政党或与政党有关联。

en.s: Caravana de Campeones (2017) (Spanish for "Caravan of Champions") was a major annual lucha libre event produced and scripted by Mexican Lucha Libre, or professional wrestling promotion, International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG). The show was held on September 17, 2017in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico, IWRG's main arena. The 2017 version of the event was the tenth overall show IWRG has held under the Caravana de Campeones banner.

zh.s: 2017年冠军巡回赛（Caravana de Campeones，意为“冠军巡回”）是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团举办并编排的一场大型年度自由式摔角赛事。比赛于2017年9月17日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行，该场馆是该集团的主场。这是国际摔角革命集团举办的第十届冠军巡回赛。

en.s: The 2017 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was a Gaelic football match played at Croke Park in Dublin on 17 September 2017 between Dublin and Mayo, the culmination of the 2017 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship. It was the 130th final of that sport's primary competition, the All-Ireland Senior Football Championship. This was the fourth occasion that the two counties met in the final, following matches in 1921, 2013 and 2016.

zh.t: 2017年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2017年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是盖尔式足球比赛，于2017年9月17日在都柏林的克罗克公园举行，由都柏林队对阵梅奥队。比赛决出该届全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛冠军，也是这项主要赛事的第130届决赛。两队此前曾在1921年、2013年和2016年三次于决赛相遇。

en.s: The 2021 Victory Road was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling. It was taped at Skyway Studios in Nashville, Tennessee on August 17 and September 17, 2021, and aired on Impact Plus and YouTube on September 18, 2021. It was the 12th event under the Victory Road chronology, and the first Impact Plus special to stream on YouTube, following the launch of the "Impact Wrestling Insiders" membership program on the platform. 10 matches were contested at the event.

zh.s: 2021年胜利之路是Impact摔角举办的一场职业摔角赛事。比赛于2021年8月17日和9月17日在田纳西州纳什维尔的Skyway Studios录制，并于9月18日在Impact Plus和YouTube播出。这是胜利之路系列第12场赛事，也是Impact Plus特别节目首次在YouTube播出；此前平台推出了“Impact Wrestling Insiders”会员计划。赛事共进行了10场比赛。

en.s: The 2021 Knockouts Knockdown was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling. It was taped on September 17, 2021, at Skyway Studios in Nashville, Tennessee, and aired on October 9, 2021, on Impact Plus and YouTube. It was the sixth event in the Knockouts Knockdown chronology, the first event to be held since 2017, and the first to be held since the discontinuation of Impact's One Night Only series in 2019.

zh.s: 2021年淘汰赛击倒赛是Impact摔角举办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2021年9月17日在田纳西州纳什维尔的Skyway Studios录制，并于10月9日在Impact Plus和YouTube播出。这是“淘汰赛击倒”系列第六场赛事，也是该系列自2017年以来首次举办；Impact的“One Night Only”系列于2019年停办后，这也是首次再度举办该赛事。

en.s: Homenaje a Dos Leyendas (2021) (Spanish for "Homage to Two Legends") was a professional wrestling supercard event, produced and scripted by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; Spanish for "World Wrestling Council"), that took place on September 17, 2021. It was originally scheduled to take place on March 20, 2020, but on March 14, CMLL announced that due to guidelines issued by the Mexican government, the Homenaje a Dos Leyendas show would be postponed to a future date.

zh.s: 2021年致敬两位传奇（Homenaje a Dos Leyendas，意为“向两位传奇致敬”）是墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办并编排的一场职业摔角大型赛事，于2021年9月17日举行。赛事原定于2020年3月20日举行，但CMLL于3月14日宣布，根据墨西哥政府发布的指导规定，活动将延期至另行通知的日期。

en.s: The 2021 Iraqi Super Cup was the 10th edition of the Iraqi Super Cup. It was held on 17 September 2021 between the 2020–21 Iraqi Premier League champions and FA Cup winners Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya and the league's runners-up Al-Zawraa. This was Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya's sixth Super Cup appearance overall while Al-Zawraa extended their record to eight appearances.

zh.s: 2021年伊拉克超级杯是第10届伊拉克超级杯，于2021年9月17日举行。对阵双方是2020—21赛季伊拉克超级联赛和足协杯冠军空军队，以及联赛亚军扎瓦拉队。这是空军队第六次参加超级杯，扎瓦拉队则将纪录扩大到八次参赛。

en.s: On 17 September 2024, gunmen from a cell of Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) attacked several locations across Bamako, the capital of Mali, including Malian Army and Wagner Group bases and Modibo Keita International Airport. en.s: The Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement (SMDA) is a security and defence pact between the countries of Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. Under this agreement both countries have committed to treating any act of aggression against one as an act against both known as collective security. The pact was signed on 17 September 2025 at Al-Yamamah Palace in Riyadh, by Saudi crown prince and Prime Minister, Mohammed bin Salman and Pakistani prime minister Shehbaz Sharif, during a state visit of the latter to Saudi Arabia.

zh.s: 《战略互防协议》（SMDA）是巴基斯坦与沙特阿拉伯之间的安全与防务协定。两国承诺将针对一方的任何侵略行为视为针对双方的行为，实行集体安全。2025年9月17日，在巴基斯坦总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫对沙特进行国事访问期间，沙特王储兼首相穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼与谢里夫在利雅得亚玛玛宫签署该协定。

Na Hong-jin, South Korean film director, producer and screenwriter served as President of the Competition jury.
